cover_headline: India Cuts Visa Categories From 13 to Nine, Renames Tourist Visa as Visitor Visa
facts: India will consolidate its 13 main visa categories into nine and cut sub-categories from 49 to 23, under a Union Home Ministry review of the Visa Manual, 2019
The Tourist Visa has been renamed the Visitor Visa, split into V-1 for short visits and V-2 for longer stays
Application form fields are to be cut by about 70% by removing overlapping and repetitive questions

end.headline: India Cuts Visa Categories From 13 to Nine, Renames Tourist Visa as Visitor Visa
end.line: Sub-categories fall from 49 to 23 and application forms are to lose about 70% of their fields under the Home Ministry's Visa Manual review.
